who: The tall, charismatic leader of the Sanguinesti Myreque, who escaped the Meiyerditch ghettos years ago and helped found the resistance. He runs the hidden base beneath northern Meiyerditch, scouting Castle Drakan and planning against the Drakans, and carries a power against vampyres he cannot control or remember using. He wants the people of Meiyerditch to have something real to hope for.
